# YourScene

> YourScene is a mobile app (iOS & Android) that shows the real-time crowd energy of live events, nightlife venues, and watch parties near you — so you find where the scene actually is, not an empty room. Tagline: "Feel the crowd. Find your scene." Launching first for the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

## What it does
- Live crowd-density scores for bars, venues, and events happening now
- A real-time energy map (green = buzzing) of the city
- Find friends, groups, and your country's crowd at venues
- "Fan Passport": your interests, tribes, and identity
- For venues: free featured listings, verification, and fan matching

## Who it's for
Sports fans, nightlife-goers, and event-goers (roughly 18-40) who want to find the best crowd near them. Initial focus: World Cup 2026 soccer fans in New York City.

- Where to watch the World Cup in NYC (guide): https://yourscene.netlify.app/where-to-watch-world-cup-nyc
